hypothesis: Native crop utility is limited by information lost when the full image is encoded once. Re-encoding real candidate crops with the same frozen V9 tower adds useful candidate-specific observations beyond a spatially structured readout of the old grid.
temporal_rule: Exact frozen R54 frame set; no R71 budget combination in this experiment

arms.A: Frozen, identity-verified R70 topsoft checkpoint on old 2305 features; competitive control, not a loss-matched arm
arms.B: Old 2305 features plus 2x2 area-weighted pooling of the same candidate ROI in the original full-image grid
arms.C: Old 2305 features plus 2x2 area-weighted pooling after the actual candidate image is re-encoded by the shared frozen V9 tower

baseline_reproduction.rule: Stop on mismatched frozen A/data identity; inspect artifacts, never substitute a same-shaped head

encoder.name: V9 vision-only SigLIP2
encoder.full_grid: Discard odd last token row/column exactly as R70 before old/ROI features
encoder.crop_grid: Use valid tokens only; preserve all valid rows/columns for 2x2 pooling
encoder.crop_sampling: PIL bicubic EXTENT with continuous source box and ceil crop width/height; no square warp, no EXIF rotation

batch_parity.images: First selected public full image plus candidates 0,64,128; single-image versus mixed-shape batch
batch_parity.scope: FP16 implementation consistency diagnostic; not a model-performance tolerance

paired_training.loss: mean squared error against mean annotator continuous IoU over the same 129 candidates
paired_training.head: R70 Head.make(d=5377), identical initialization rule and optimizer in B/C
paired_training.checkpoint_selection: Final fixed step only; never select a checkpoint or seed by DEV
paired_training.normalization: Train rows only, independently for old and added observations

diagnostic.permutation: Permute only C local candidate features within each public frame; preserve old features, candidate positions, weights and output boxes
diagnostic.content_alignment_condition: C must lose mean IoU under candidate permutation in each DEV domain and seed; otherwise stop the candidate-content explanation. This is supporting evidence, not an independent causal proof.
diagnostic.uncertainty_scope: Source-paired uncertainty on already exposed public DEV; not independent confirmation or an official-score predictor

engineering_gate.required_for: Each fixed seed, separately in rv_dev and live_dev
engineering_gate.after_results: Do not lower the gate or add seed/parameter sweeps

parameter_inventory.R85_head: Count actual loaded parameters; no B3 head, YuNet, A-control checkpoint, or B-control checkpoint in C deployment
parameter_inventory.status: No weights loaded in this session; full inference inventory still requires verification
